display.purpose: Hero headings and page-level statements. Never more than one per section.

headline.purpose: Section headings (h2). Primary reading anchor per content zone.

title.purpose: Sub-headings, card titles, modal titles (h3). Inherits Marcellus roman weight.

body.purpose: All prose. Line length capped 65-75ch. Line-height 1.7 for sustained reading comfort.

label.purpose: Section category tags and badges. Sparingly — not above every heading by default.

shadows.name: resting-surface
shadows.purpose: Cards, navbar on scroll, dropdowns. Warm ambient presence at rest.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Cards and interactive surfaces on hover. Always paired with translateY(-2px) scale(1.01).

shadows.name: dropdown-modal
shadows.purpose: Language selector dropdown, modal box. More presence to confirm layer separation.

motion.name: section-appear
motion.purpose: Section-level entrance. Applied to sections, cards, .section-padding, .hero-slide, and named card classes.

motion.name: hover-lift
motion.purpose: Hover response on interactive cards and section-tags.

motion.name: card-arrow-rotate
motion.purpose: The 44px circle arrow icon on service cards. Signature interaction gesture.

motion.name: image-pan
motion.purpose: Service card image on hover. Slower than standard to feel physical, not digital.

motion.name: readmore-gap
motion.purpose: Readmore link: the gap between label and arrow widens on hover. The direction is the delight.

motion.name: preloader-spin-reverse
motion.purpose: Inner gold arc ring — opposite direction.

motion.name: reduced-motion-override
motion.purpose: Fallback for prefers-reduced-motion: replace all transform animations with a fade.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Section padding reduces to 60px; navbar shows hamburger; service grids collapse.

breakpoints.name: container
breakpoints.purpose: Max-width for cr-container. Beyond this, margins grow and content stays centered.

breakpoints.name: container-wide
breakpoints.purpose: Used by HomeServicesSection for the wider services wrapper.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA. Pill-shaped, olive fill. Used for 'Book Appointment', 'View Services', primary page actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background-color: #414E36; color: #FBFBF9; font-family: 'Sora', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 50px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.3s ease, transform 0.2s ease; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #2E3A26; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C4AE7C; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary CTA. Same pill shape, no fill. Sand border at rest. Used for 'Learn More', 'View All'.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background-color: transparent; color: #1F251A; font-family: 'Sora', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 13px 28px; border-radius: 50px; border: 1.5px solid #F2EFE9; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-outline:hover, .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { background-color: rgba(251, 251, 249, 0.5); color: #1F251A; outline: none; }

components.name: Filter Pill
components.description: Category selector for services and blog. Gold border at rest, olive fill on active.
components.css: .ds-filter-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 50px; border: 1.5px solid #C4AE7C; font-family: 'Sora', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s ease; background: transparent; color: #414E36; } .ds-filter-pill.active, .ds-filter-pill:hover { background-color: #414E36; color: #FBFBF9; border-color: #414E36; } .ds-filter-pill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C4AE7C; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Service Card
components.description: Content card with title, body, image, and rotating arrow icon. Signature component.
components.html:
Skin Dermatology Clinics

Specialized care for all skin conditions, from diagnostics to advanced dermatology treatments.
components.css: .ds-service-card { background-color: #FBFBF9; border-radius: 24px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid rgba(90, 106, 81, 0.2); box-shadow: 0 2px 20px rgba(90, 61, 52, 0.08); display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100%; transition: transform 0.24s ease, box-shadow 0.24s ease; } .ds-service-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px) scale(1.01); box-shadow: 0 16px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08); } .ds-service-card-body { padding: 24px; flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px; } .ds-service-card-header { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 14px; } .ds-service-card-title { margin: 0; font-family: 'Marcellus', Georgia, serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 400; color: #414E36; line-height: 1.1; flex: 1; } .ds-arrow-icon { width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; background-color: rgba(90, 106, 81, 0.12); display: grid; place-items: center; flex-shrink: 0; transition: transform 0.28s ease; } .ds-service-card:hover .ds-arrow-icon { transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-service-card-desc { margin: 0; font-family: 'Sora', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #5A6A51; line-height: 1.8; } .ds-service-card-image { width: 100%; height: 220px; border-radius: 24px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-service-card-image img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 700ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.2, 1); } .ds-service-card:hover .ds-service-card-image img { transform: scale(1.06) rotate(-1deg); }

components.name: Category Card
components.description: Large selection card for service categories. Centered icon + serif label + Sora sublabel. Hover: border shifts to olive.
components.css: .ds-category-card { flex: 1; min-width: 280px; padding: 48px 32px; border-radius: 24px; border: 1.5px solid rgba(90, 106, 81, 0.15); background: #FBFBF9; color: #414E36; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.3s ease; text-align: center; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(90, 61, 52, 0.02); } .ds-category-card:hover { border-color: #414E36; box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(90, 61, 52, 0.08); } .ds-category-label { font-family: 'Marcellus', Georgia, serif; font-size: 22px; color: #414E36; margin-bottom: 6px; font-weight: 400; } .ds-category-sublabel { font-family: 'Sora', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #5A6A51; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form input. Gold border at rest, olive on focus. Placeholder uses gold color.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 14px 18px; border: 1.5px solid #C4AE7C; border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'Sora', ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #414E36; background: #FBFBF9; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.3s ease; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #414E36; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #C4AE7C; }

narrative.overview:
A clinic that grows from its landscape. The space is olive-green rooms, warm-toned instruments, natural materials held in careful order. Patients enter somewhere that takes both their appearance and their time seriously — the calm precision of a surgeon, the welcoming stillness of a cultivated garden. Science and nature are not in tension here; they are one system.

The palette descends from this: deep olive green carries authority without coldness, warm royal gold marks precision without display, warm ivory and sage tint form the canvas the way stone and linen form a room. Nothing announces itself. The luxury is the absence of noise.

This system rejects three anti-patterns by name. The first is the generic pharma palette: cold blue-and-white clinical hygiene photography that could belong to any hospital anywhere. The second is the overcrowded low-budget clinic template: competing fonts, banner overload, no visual hierarchy. The third is the sterile SaaS shell: metric-hero layouts, rounded-card grids, gradient CTAs designed for a subscription product, not a body and a physician.
keyCharacteristics: Deep olive green and warm gold are the dominant color voices; the ivory canvas recedes entirely
Marcellus serif headings carry old-world authority; Sora body text is precise and legible
Animation is intentional: 3D perspective entrance, custom preloader arcs, subtle hover lifts — not a reflex applied to every element equally
Full bilingual (EN/AR) — RTL is a first-class layout mode, not a toggle
Warm olive-brown ambient shadows throughout; cold gray is prohibited

rules.name: The Gold Restraint Rule
rules.body: Gold (#C4AE7C) appears on input borders, focus states, and decorative accents — never on primary text or buttons. The moment it appears in more than 15% of a screen, reduce it. Its warmth reads only because it is rare.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows use rgba(90, 61, 52, …) — an olive-brown tint — never neutral gray or pure black. Cold shadows break the sanctuary atmosphere. If a shadow looks gray, it's wrong.

rules.name: The Marcellus Weight Rule
rules.body: Marcellus ships in one weight (regular 400). Do not attempt to bold headings by adding font-weight: 700; the font has no bold variant and the browser will synthesize a distorted stroke. Size and scale carry heading hierarchy; weight does not.

rules.name: The RTL Symmetry Rule
rules.body: All font sizes, line heights, and spacing scale identically in Arabic mode. The body.rtl class flips text direction; it changes nothing else. Do not introduce Arabic-only size overrides unless a specific glyph set demands it.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Shadows are permanent structural elements (not hover-only), but the hover state amplifies them. Every interactive surface has a resting shadow and a lifted shadow — two tiers of elevation that make the hover gesture feel physical.

dos: Do use rgba(90, 61, 52, …) — the warm olive-brown — as the shadow tint on every box-shadow.
Do let body text sit at #1F251A on #FBFBF9 backgrounds. Verify contrast before introducing any secondary text color.
Do use Marcellus at regular weight (400) for all headings. Never synthesize bold.
Do apply text-wrap: balance on h1–h3 elements, particularly in bilingual mode.
Do animate the arrow icon (44px circle, rotate(45deg) on hover) on every interactive card. It is the system's characteristic gesture.
Do add @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) fallbacks for all transform-based animations.
Do use gold (#C4AE7C) for input borders at rest and focus rings on non-input elements.
donts: Don't use generic pharma blue-and-white. No cold clinical palette, no stock-photo white hallways.
Don't let the layout become overcrowded. No competing font families, no banner stacking.
Don't use the SaaS metric-hero template: big stat + small label + gradient accent.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text). Gold is too specific a brand signal to dissolve.
Don't use border-left greater than 1px as an accent stripe on cards or callouts.
Don't add uppercase tracked section eyebrows above every heading. The section-tag class is used selectively.
Don't use cold gray box-shadows. If a shadow looks neutral or blue-shifted, replace it with the warm olive-brown tint.
Don't introduce a fourth typeface. Marcellus + Sora is the system.
Don't build RTL as an afterthought. Arabic mode must mirror layout direction, not just swap text.
